svg.aria-label: Architecture. Browser sessions flow through the collector, Pub/Sub, the processor and the clusterer into Cloud Storage, BigQuery and Firestore. The agent service turns issues into ranked findings, and turns sentences from the churn watcher, a merchant or the rule suggester into rules through one pipeline. A person approves each rule; it then goes live in the processor and a re-scan replays raw chunks into the signals topic. The API and dashboard read the stores and forward rule actions to the agent.
